en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Musna, from Sadeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Begin with Makkah and end with us<sup>asws</sup> (at Al-Medina)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn af-Muthanna’ from Sadir who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
you should commence with Makkah and end with us.”
